## What

Readable listing decisions from #1633.

## Why

Review explanations outside literal interfaces.

## Architecture

The engine publishes the listing and its landing commands.

### Session verdict — `onepipeline` (`src/verbs.rs`)

The engine owns the listing.

#### Public unpublished listing

**Reversibility: high cost** — External CLI and SDK consumers would have to change their calls and parsers.

Session reads select launcher-labelled Decision rows across all identities; a mismatched label or incomplete recovery read is unanswered, never none. A row counts only when it has no holder, its landed state is no, unknown or in-part, and no acknowledgement matches its identity, branch and current tip; a null tip cannot be acknowledged as standing.

```text
onepipeline unpublished
  [--session <ID> | --host | --token <S-TOKEN>...]
  [--format text|json] [--disk] [--acknowledgements <DIR>]
  [--pr-author-graph <PATH>]

--session: defaults to ONEPIPELINE_LAUNCHER_SESSION; blank refused.
--host: all registered identities, empty Selection.
--token: Selection.sessions; unknown token refused.
--format: text by default.
--disk: opt-in allocated-byte reads; never used by Stop guard.
Exit: 0 none; 7 owed; 1 unanswered; 2 refused.
SDK: a src/verbs.rs function, with binary parity held by tests/parity.rs.
```

```typescript
// JSON wire schema. All listed keys are present; nullable values use null.
// Arrays may be empty. Integer aliases describe JSON numbers, not strings.
type UInt = number;    // integer >= 0
type PositiveInt = number; // integer >= 1
type Sha = string;    // onevcs host::Sha, a transparent commit-hash string;
                      // no new fixed-width restriction is imposed here
type Url = string;    // serialized url::Url
type SessionToken = string; // onevcs session::SessionToken
type Labels = { [key: string]: string };

type Listing = {
  target: { kind: "session"; session: string }
        | { kind: "host" }
        | { kind: "tokens"; tokens: SessionToken[] };
  verdict: "none" | "owed" | "unanswered";
  rows: Row[];
  unresolved: string[];
};
type Row = {
  identity: string;                  // repository identity
  branch: string;                    // branch name
  base: string;                      // base branch name
  provenance: "complete" | "incomplete-step";
  tip: string | null;                // full commit object name in row's checkout;
                                     // null only when branch ref cannot be read
  landed: Landed;
  change_url: Url | null;
  stopped_because: string;           // may be "" under Decision
  session: SessionToken | null;
  run: string | null;                // run label, else null
  node: string | null;               // node label, else null
  manager_session: string | null;    // launcher label, else null
  recover_command: string[];         // whole onevcs argv
  land_command: string[];            // rewritten landing argv;
                                     // [] when recover_command is empty
  retirement: Retirement | null;     // whole onevcs value; absence caveat below
  in_flight: boolean;                // whether onevcs reports held_by
  counted: boolean;                  // no holder, counted landed state,
                                     // and no standing acknowledgement
  acknowledgement: Acknowledgement | null;
  disk: Disk | null;                 // null when disk reading not requested
};
type Landed =
  | { state: "yes"; evidence: LandingEvidence }
  | { state: "in-part"; evidence: LandingEvidence; unlanded: PositiveInt }
  | { state: "no" }
  | { state: "unknown" };
type LandingEvidence =
  | { tier: "recorded-landing"; commit: Sha }
  | { tier: "change-request"; commit: Sha; change_url: Url }
  | { tier: "trailer"; commit: Sha };

type Retirement = {
  class: "retirable" | "superseded-with-changes" | "keep";
  reason: KeepReason | null;
  cause: UnknownCause | null;
  identity: string;
  branch: string;
  tip: Sha;
  base: string;
  proof: RetirementProof | null;
  content_free_commits: Sha[];
  superseded_by: SupersededBy | null;
  differing_paths: string[];
  holders: BranchHolder[];
};
type KeepReason = "held-by-live-session" | "excluded" | "open-change-request"
  | "checked-out" | "dirty-worktree" | "unmerged-unique-commits"
  | "unknown" | "is-base";
type UnknownCause = {
  operation: string;  // nonblank; open vocabulary, not an enum
  subject: string;    // nonblank path, origin or change-request description
  error: string;      // nonblank diagnostic
};
type RetirementProof =
  | { kind: "merged-change-request"; change_url: Url; head: Sha }
  | { kind: "recorded-landing"; commit: Sha }
  | { kind: "content-identical"; base_commit: Sha };
type SupersededBy = {
  branch: string;
  landing: string;    // recorded commit or change-request URL
  labels: Labels;
};
type BranchHolder = {
  kind: "checkout" | "slot" | "run-clone" | "origin";
  location: string;   // path, or origin URL for kind "origin"
};
// Retirement relationships from onevcs, not independent optional decisions:
// reason is non-null exactly for keep; proof exactly for retirable.
// cause can be non-null only with reason unknown; older records may lack it.
// superseded-with-changes names superseded_by.
// differing_paths is nonempty for superseded-with-changes and for keep with
// unmerged-unique-commits (the producer's documented output relationship).

type Acknowledgement = {
  branch: string;
  identity: string;
  tip: string;       // 40–64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
  reason: string;    // nonblank, single line
  at: string;        // UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ
};
type Disk = {
  run_root: string | null;     // run-root path; current wrapper permits null
  run_root_bytes: UInt | null; // allocated bytes; null is not measured zero
  build_output: {
    [name: string]: UInt;     // present entries from target, node_modules,
                              // .venv, .nx, dist; map may be empty
  };
};
```

Authority and limits of this schema:
The task op-unpublished-verdict fixes the new listing's fields, targets,
verdicts, argv arrays, label nulls and acknowledgement format. onevcs v0.42.0
crates/onevcs/src/session.rs (Recoverable, PreservedBranch, Provenance),
landed.rs (Landed, LandingEvidence), retire.rs (Retirement and nested types)
and host.rs (Sha) supply the unchanged nested wire types above.
The producer task adds tip; Decision may return change_url null and
stopped_because empty. Nested onevcs objects are passed through whole,
not projected onto a smaller local evidence schema.

Not separately fixed by the plan: absent-retirement normalization and disk
failure/missing-path representation. The schema above shows the existing
orchestrator/unpublished.py Row/_rendered and Disk.entry behaviour:
retirement null when the optional producer value is absent; nullable disk
path/byte count and an empty or partial build-output map. onevcs itself
omits absent Recoverable.retirement. The task names the output key and a
Disk object but does not explicitly settle those edge encodings or their
unresolved/verdict effects. These are current behaviour to reconcile in
the engine's canonical types, not newly approved choices in this document;
any shared-contract departure must go to the manager.

Disk covers the parent of `<s-token>/worktree` and its named build outputs
without following symlinks. Text lists counted rows with landing and
acknowledgement commands, marks in-flight and acknowledged rows, and ends
with a summary. For superseded-with-changes, evidence and onevcs reclaim
come first. Unresolved diagnostics go to stderr in text and unresolved
in JSON.

Printed landing argv selects the engine publication verbs:

```text
recover_command publish-branch -> onepipeline publish-branch <same args>
recover_command recover        -> onepipeline repo-recover <same args>
```

Append `--pr-author-graph <absolute PATH>` when configured; otherwise append `--no-draft` and say no drafter is configured. integrate and reclaim remain onevcs verbs. Unreadable graph path: exit 2 before reading recovery evidence.

#### Existing state remains readable

**Reversibility: high cost** — Older installed readers keep their records.

Registry and session formats remain readable. This behavioural decision has no new stored shape.

#### Literal output remains literal

**Reversibility: high cost** — Consumers copy the literal output.

Indented output may contain backticks, including inline `code`.

````````````text
  first
    ```json
    {"literal": "```"}
    ```
  last
````````````

The next command is separate explanatory context.

```bash
onepipeline unpublished
  --host
```

## Acceptance criteria

- Explanations are prose and commands remain literal.
